purpose: Generated visual references, not installed in-game art.
limitations: Illustrative generated views, not dimensionally validated orthographic drawings. Sprite is enlarged pixel-style art; exact native resolution and color count unverified.
model_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a four-view orthographic model sheet of the exact robotic KANGAROO in the attached eight-view sprite sheet. Image 1 is the authoritative current design. Four separated views in a spacious 2x2 grid: upper left true SIDE elevation FACING RIGHT; upper right true FRONT elevation; lower left true BACK elevation; lower right front-right THREE-QUARTER orthographic view. All at the SAME SCALE, consistent body and ear heights. Side/front/back are technical elevations with no elevated camera, no perspective; side should show a clean profile rather than another three-quarter view. Clean cel-shaded illustration with 2–3 tones per material, dark colored seam lines between armor plates, flat even lighting. Completely flat neutral medium grey background, no vignette or cast shadows. No text, labels or logos.

Preserve this machine's exact design and proportions: upright kangaroo with two tall slender orange ear blades, angular orange head and long pointed muzzle, tiny flat cyan eyes, long exposed stacked charcoal mechanical neck; broad orange armored pear-shaped torso and belly/pouch with the specific inset seam geometry shown; small paired dark-and-steel forearms/hardware held forward at upper chest with short orange-ended barrels; preserve asymmetric shoulder-mounted pods as shown rather than inventing symmetrical new hardware. Large round grey hip hubs on orange haunches, powerful bent charcoal-and-steel hind legs with orange armor and long orange segmented feet. Long thick tapered orange segmented tail, separated by dark joint bands, sweeping backwards and down, with a small grey tip fitting. Match all eight views for shoulder pod placement, back panels, pouch/chest hardware, circular joints and leg structure. Keep the chest as drawn, no biological fur or skin, no invented boxing gloves, extra limbs, wings, added ears/antennas or weapons. Main color saturated burnt orange/vermilion with lighter orange facets, charcoal mechanical structure and grey steel details. Tiny cyan eyes have no glow, bloom, aura or light spill. This is the user's own machine, not a redesign.
sprite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE finished battle sprite of the exact robotic KANGAROO in the attached current eight-view sprite sheet, in the pixel-art language of GBA Zoids Legacy battle sprites. The attached image is the sole shape/design reference. One full-body kangaroo facing RIGHT, camera approximately 18 degrees above ground and rotated 20 degrees toward the viewer from a side profile. Both tall ears, muzzle, entire tail and both feet visible within generous margins. Keep its upright heavy pear-shaped body and crouched kangaroo hind-leg stance, compact forearms held forward at upper chest. Flat uniform medium neutral grey background, no gradient, with one thin straight VIOLET ground line at the feet. No text, labels, logos, borders, other views or scenery.

Pixel art: roughly 120 logical pixels tall, enlarged with clean nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Target 30–35 carefully chosen colors in long material ramps. Upper-left lighting. Darker shades of each material's own hue for the outlines, NEVER pure black. Deliberate crisp pixel clusters, legible flat armor faces and tiny metal edge highlights, orderly mechanical detailing appropriate for a handheld game sprite. No antialiasing, painterly blur, photorealistic 3D rendering, glow, bloom or eye light spill.

Faithfully preserve this machine's proportions and construction: saturated orange/vermilion segmented armor with warm orange highlights, charcoal mechanical structure and grey steel joints. Two tall narrow orange ears, angular head, long tapered pointed muzzle, tiny flat cyan eyes, long exposed stacked dark mechanical neck. Broad orange belly/pouch with the exact panel seam arrangement in the source, bulky orange haunches around circular grey hip hubs, deeply bent dark articulated hind legs with grey connectors and long orange segmented feet. Thick long tapered orange tail extending backward and down, dark bands between its segments and a small steel end fitting. Preserve the pair of compact dark-and-steel chest forearms with short orange-ended barrels and the distinct asymmetric shoulder pods, matching their reference locations. Follow the sheet's back and side panels without inventing extra guns or multiplying hardware. No boxing gloves, fur, skin, extra limbs, wings, head antennas or redesign. This is the user's own kangaroo machine translated faithfully into a beautifully finished game sprite reference.
